name: Forbearance
lore: An anomaly of restriction, for the protectors who seek purpose outside of reality.

name: Nonexistence
lore: What lies beneath the brim of all that never was, that overflowing vastness which cannot spill?

name: Collection
lore: An anomaly of adoption, for the caretakers who seek purpose outside of reality.

name: Simulacrum
lore: An anomaly of replication, for the assemblers who seek purpose outside of reality.

name: Inconceivably Deranged Paper Mask of Legendary Victory
lore: This cheap paper mask drawn in the likeness of Herbert von Legendary as he was having a complete nervous breakdown after having his life threatened by people who would not stop challenging him, is handed over in the ill-conceived hope of easing the murderous tendencies of those who have spent unnecessary amounts of time, broken the mold, gone even further beyond, pushed onward to prove that they will not stop, ultimately garnered an unhealthy obsession, and then came to blows in Doctor Legendary's house demanding further prizes all for the singularly unsettling and quite possibly sociopathic purpose of spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge. The inside has the names and addresses of multiple notable psychoanalysts written with a hastily-scrawled note from Doctor Legendary himself begging that you stop completing the Legendary Challenge and go get therapy before you do something to him that would constitute legal action against you.

name: Fractal
lore: Curious, isn't it, that unending complexity can feel so plain in one's hand, yet pull deeper than eyes can see and minds can fathom?

name: Adherence
lore: Adherence to the laws of good is important- it’s why one fights the spread of corruption, after all. Though whether to follow the spirit or the letter… perhaps they too can be bent to your will.

name: Recursion
lore: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.

name: Infinitesimal
lore: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.

name: Thought Energy
lore: Limitless light fills the vast expanse of your mind.  Harness even a fraction of its potential, and you can command a force to shake worlds.

name: Aleph Null
lore: It's a strange feeling, running forever to reach the horizon knowing another lies just as far past.

name: Detachment
lore: An anomaly of separation, for the wanderers who seek purpose outside of reality.

name: Breakthrough
lore: An anomaly of destruction, for the conquerors who seek purpose outside of reality.

name: Continuum
lore: From nothing to everything, forever past to forever more, the vastness of eternity is obscured by the sameness of tomorrow.

name: Divergence
lore: Strangers held together by shared past, entwined in a fray, never to unite again.

name: Ingress
lore: An anomaly of invasion, for the explorers who seek purpose outside of reality.

name: Albatross
lore: And lo, a single bolt did fly, ensured the bird's grace ever lost, and pierced its wings out from the sky, the day you shot the albatross.

name: Taciturn
lore: The Expanse holds an exigent paranoia, a hamartia for even the most renowned heroes. Only a survivor knows to hoard intelligence, showing their hand only when none will be left to recount it.

name: Umami
lore: Rumors circulate of a once-cook from Lutho who managed to achieve the perfect meal. In their final days, they preserved its essence in this necklace, in a hope that someone else would be able to share the experience they had.

name: Resonance
lore: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.

name: Convergence
lore: As the void approaches nearer and nearer, the barrier between realms thins almost to a point... And yet, no matter how far you fall or how fast you fly, it will always lie just out of reach. Such is the indeterminate nature of the void, and its power that you harness.

name: Outlandish Replica Face Mask of Legendary Victory
lore: This perfect-to-the-point-of-indistinguishability replica mask of Herbert von Legendary's face, painstakingly crafted by Corkus's most powerful machines with only the most expensive materials and featuring real moustache hair plucked from Doctor Legendary's face, is desperately handed over to attempt to placate those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then ultimately garnered an unhealthy obsession for spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

name: Labyrinth
lore: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right.  Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?

name: Trance
lore: Down. Your enemies will fall slack. Deeper. Do you know this compulsion you bring? Deeper still. This implement, reaching from within and without. Even deeper. Souls and wills to command at the flex of a finger. Almost gone. It is my compulsion, too great to ignore. It is my implement, too strong to resist. My puppets, too deep to escape. Drop.

name: Martingale
lore: Every power has its costs, and every triumph has its toll. Wager everything you treasure—it will all be worth in the end.

name: Death Grasp
lore: Unspeakable things live within the shadows; waiting so patiently to take others into their ranks. Facsimiles of their existence, painted in inscrutable darkness. Nobody will see. Nobody will know. Nobody will remember.

name: Wanderlust
lore: Are your heart, soul, and mind one? The ones who love are the most vulnerable. The ones who persist are the most detached. The ones who forget are the most naive. Only when you remove these impurities from your body could you reach the end.

name: Abhorrence
lore: The last of her crimes was against herself. She reviled and hated, shattering any glass in which she might see her own cruel visage.

name: Phantasmal Hostage
lore: A soul sacrificed willingly, to an eternity in captivity. Imprints and memories; all that remain of a hero of the lands.

name: Brutality
lore: Her crimes were against Man. She killed and broke, leaving lifeless bodies piled in her wake, and snuffing lives with horrific indifference.

name: Swindler's Charm
lore: This relic has been passed down through the ages, from conman to charlatan to chiseller. It grants an inexplicable sense of candor to your words.

name: Animosity
lore: Let its whispers guide your hand, and let nothing but a scar of resentment remain.

name: Bloodbath
lore: Blood. Carnage. Death. Destruction. This is all Annihilation knows. A fury written into its very core, a violent rage building from an endless War. If it were to have its way, all of Wynn would fall to chaos.

name: Myopia
lore: In such a sinister and wicked expanse, one wonders if the best solution is to give up your eyes and replace them with a pair that does not indulge in such evils, cleansing them from your idyllic field of view while the wider world around you withers away.

name: Malevolent Urge
lore: You wouldn't even think of committing these atrocities, would you? But what if you weren't the one in control?

name: Sacrilege
lore: The first of her crimes was against the Church. She blasphemed and raved, cursing with the names of gods long-abandoned.

name: Petulance
lore: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.

name: Renegade
lore: Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.

name: Quetzalcoatl
lore: The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.

name: Treasured Diamond Mask of Legendary Victory
lore: This excessively ornate to-the-point-of-being-wasteful decorative mask, laser-cut from a meter's worth of pure diamond, is given to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

name: Viridian
lore: An attempt to discover opulence in stone; greed-fueled destruction and avaricious growth. Too far. Chaos was brought into the world, and greed begat death.

name: Withstand
lore: Despite the valley being overtaken by anomalous forces, the toughest flora has managed to avoid extinction. Their coiling vines and roots remind you that even in the most dire of situations, you will never go quietly.

name: Consolidate
lore: An attempt to contain dark within light, to strike back at brutality with compassion.  Reality protested. Bring together two forces, and all you have is discord.

name: Flagellant
lore: An attempt to penetrate the depths of the abyss; a sacrifice made to a futile end. No avail. Bloodshed paved the way for bloodshed, and evil still operates while blind.

name: Hypoxia
lore: You need to keep moving. You can't stop here. You can't. You can't breathe. You can't run. You're dying. You can't keep on. You can't. You can't.

name: Hanafubuki
lore: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.

name: Idealogue
lore: An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.

name: Epoch
lore: This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.

name: Lost Seconds
lore: This ring is set with a beautiful, mesmerizing gem. You could look at it for hours. Hours and hours and hours.

name: Venerated Gold Mask of Legendary Victory
lore: This excessively ornate decorative mask, moulded from 24 carat gold, is awarded to those who have both spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

name: Surveillance
lore: An attempt to rule with an iron fist, a power hellbent on control and force.  Unknown. How far does the indomitable spirit of humanity extend?

name: Fragile Truce
lore: The enemy of your enemy is your friend. It’s naught but a ceasefire of convenience, if not necessity, yet it’s a chance to lick your wounds and focus your might against the threat at hand.

name: Oblivion
lore: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the Tower of Ascension, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.

name: Black Space
lore: Give yourself to darkness, and in darkness, answers will take shape.

name: Impossibility Threshold
lore: Visions unknowable and faces unnamed. A violent cacophony with no end in sight. But beyond that- a clarity. A fleeting moment where the rules speak their names, just on the other side. You need to get closer. You need to be able to see.

name: Keratoconus
lore: The unearthly wood of eyestalk is durable, but with horrific cost. Pieces severed from the trunk continue to collect and cultivate the essence of abandoned eyes, and the unfortunate wearer becomes a catalyst for growth.

name: Revered Silver Mask of Legendary Victory
lore: This ornate decorative mask, fashioned from pure silver, is awarded to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

name: Panic Zealot
lore: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.

name: Immolation
lore: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism—purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.

name: Contrast
lore: The runes carved onto the gold beads strung along this simple necklace translate into various words meaning variance. It provides many abilities though unexplainable means.

name: Etiolation
lore: Despite the absence of natural light, in the deepest reaches of the Void grows foliage and flora capable of sustaining itself by absorbing latent energy. Such an accomplishment is to be admired, ideally from a keen distance.

name: Planet Healer
lore: The jewels in this necklace naturally draw darkness and corruption into its wearer, purifying the land around them at the cost of their own life.

name: Compliance
lore: "All of our faith, all of our worship, and we were rewarded with the apocalypse."

name: Elysium-Engraved Aegis
lore: Dedicated to a place of courage revered by all warriors, this ornately-crafted chestplate is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

name: Obsidian-Framed Helmet
lore: Made of dark minerals and adorned with pure obsidian, this ornately-crafted helmet is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

name: Syncope
lore: The soul of a Devil is so hot with hatred that their  bodies melt like candle wax, coming off in molten globs of flesh until only black bones remain.

name: Gaea-Hewn Boots
lore: Forged in direct tribute to the earth and its aspects, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

name: Titanomachia
lore: This is futile, a fight against odds so great you may as well challenge the force of fate itself. Yet there is pride to be found in delaying the inevitable, so stand your ground and fight to the end.

name: Resolution
lore: In the moments before an all but inescapable death, time slows down, and the pace of battle becomes yours. By mastering the escape, you can face death on command, reaping the benefits at will before the reaper reaches you.

name: Abyss-Imbued Leggings
lore: Steeped in the deepest energies of the Ahms region void, these ornately-crafted leggings are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

name: Gravity
lore: No one knows how this extremely dense chestplate can even logically exist. It is almost paradoxical in nature, and affects its wearers in unfathomable ways.

name: Succession
lore: "I pray that those who have heeded the wise one’s warning have survived. The canyon must not meet this fate."

name: Eden-Blessed Guards
lore: Consecrated by Qira herself with blessings unknown to all but her, these ornately-crafted leggings are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

name: Hephaestus-Forged Sabatons
lore: Honoring a mythical dwarven smith lost to the legends, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

name: Intensity
lore: The runes carved into this simple gold ring translate into various words meaning power. It amplifies elemental energies in inexplicable ways.

name: Recalcitrance
lore: "The omens, the warnings, they were right there, and we stood by and did nothing."

name: Antebellum
lore: Only the naive celebrate a ceasefire. Not a second wasted, a merciless arms race against the inevitability of war has left you ready to unleash hell the moment the armistice breaks.

name: Anya's Penumbra
lore: "The lightest light will never defeat the darkest dark. Only those who understand both can survive."

name: Anima-Infused Cuirass
lore: Infused with the classical magicks of fire, water, and thunder, this ornately-crafted chestplate is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

name: Boreal-Patterned Crown
lore: Engraved with the beauty and mystery of the boreal lights, this ornately-crafted crown is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

name: Infused Hive Spear
lore: Deceptively plain-looking, this spear has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its tip shimmers in a spectrum of colors.

name: Twilight-Gilded Cloak
lore: An ephemeral moment in time captured by sheer force of magic, this ornately-crafted cloak is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

name: Abrasion
lore: "The fractures have ground the land to dust, our home to ruin, and our people to nothing."

name: Chaos-Woven Greaves
lore: With threads of fundamentally opposing magic delicately woven together, these ornately-crafted greaves are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

name: Infused Hive Wand
lore: Deceptively plain-looking, this wand has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It subtly glows in a spectrum of colors.

name: Mazeweaver
lore: The strong can hammer foe and nature alike into submission, waging war with indiscriminate force. The truly powerful pit them against each other on a whim, weaving stone and verdure into an elaborate web of attrition that beats with the heart of an entire world. What is an enemy compared to all the might of the Earth?

name: Infused Hive Dagger
lore: Deceptively plain-looking, this dagger has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It leaves afterimages that pulsate in a spectrum of colors.

name: Prism
lore: The jewel on this ring is found very rarely deep beneath the Light Forest. It has the power to manipulate light itself.

name: Obstinance
lore: "The protector will keep us safe even after this! It has to, it must, it—"

name: Kalorite Jewel
lore: A symbol of apology. Of pain, never intended but given carelessly. Of good intentions marred by thoughtlessness and overeager optimism. To give one of these icy pearls away is to give away part of yourself,  and to give hope to those you have hurt that they may find peace.

name: Windborne
lore: Orders, cannonfire, calls for surrender—the wind carries all. To ride the winds is to harness the lifeblood of battle, infiltrating up the veins of command with mere token resistance.

name: Dispersion
lore: "The lucky ones perished in the abyss. It’s only a matter of time before the land picks us survivors off one by one."

name: Infused Hive Relik
lore: Deceptively plain-looking, this relik has been infused with energy from all five known elements. The head gleams in a spectrum of colors.

name: Legendary Medallion
lore: This medallion marks its wearer as a true champion. It is awarded to those who have put an unnecessary amount of time into attempting the Legendary Challenge.

name: Prowess
lore: The runes carved into this simple gold cuff translate into various words meaning mastery. It amplifies the ability of the wearer in mysterious ways.

name: Insignia
lore: To wear the mark is more than a show of allegiance. It is a willingness to channel the might of the gods at whatever cost, as the fate of the battle is worth more than surviving to see its end.

name: Dondasch
lore: The sheer bond between Adamastor and Urdar has manifested itself into a physical form due to their duress. Such power is not to be abused...

name: Pisces
lore: The oddly uncomfortable helmet was hand sculpted from a mystic clay found only in the depths of Molten Heights. Not much is known about the substance.

name: Esteemed Bronze Mask of Legendary Victory
lore: This decorative mask, crafted of bronze alloys, is awarded only to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

name: Cannonade
lore: An impenetrable fortress’ greatest strength is psychological, a mythos built on the backs of a thousand attackers it has withstood. Your greatest strength is the belief that not one of those thousand could hold a candle to you.

name: Dark Matter֎
lore: It permeates around you, so subtly, enveloping your very being with a shroud on the cusp of impalpability.  Nothing can affect you now - the incorporeal hiding in plain sight.

name: Ambivalence
lore: "It's all doomed anyway. If you don't care, nothing can hurt you." - Zamugnia, Lost Lutho Citizen

name: Infused Hive Bow
lore: Deceptively plain-looking, this bow has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its string radiates a spectrum of colors.

name: Cluster
lore: Perhaps one is weak. To be ignored. Perhaps two are not much better. But what of five? Ten? Twenty?...

name: Titanium Grievers
lore: Crudely misshapen greaves made from haphazard scrap found about the Starfield. You sense a foreboding notion that donning such a thing would be the end of sensing anything at all.

name: Stinger
lore: If it weren't for that stray mark, this would be spelled correctly...

name: Sitis
lore: Wielding it for too long will leave one a dessicated husk, as this dull blade slowly absorbs all liquids around it.

name: Pandemonium
lore: Power, but at what cost?

name: Warp
lore: The notorious and erratic magical inventor Gawrick once attempted to make teleportation scrolls obsolete, by creating items which would allow the user to phase into an ethereal state to move unhindered. He did not account for the physical ramifications of this process, however.

name: Bonder
lore: It looks like they spelled the name wrong...

name: The Extinguished
lore: Everything that’s fallen down here has a purpose. Or at least, it used to. Being too far removed from said purpose will eventually smother it, but it can always be rekindled... and that’s where you come in.

name: Vaward
lore: A once-great hero left behind these sturdy, reliable greaves, trusting those after her to be able to use their power to protect others, should they don them. Her courage fuels their wearers.

name: Slider
lore: The spelling seems to have been botched.

name: Doomsday Omen
lore: Something is lurking—it must be, in the eerie silence that leaves you so utterly alone. And these remains… Are they a reminder of one who didn’t stay quiet, or does what lurks in the unknown already know you’re here?

name: Stratiformis
lore: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.

name: Black
lore: Hewn from the great obsidian spires surrounding the massive Nether gate, this fiercely-hooked dagger absorbs light and magic energy alike to create a desolate void wherever it is wielded.

name: Tidebinder
lore: This mysterious, half-liquid trident apparently holds the secret magics to control the ocean's ebb and flow. It is incapable of touching solid ground.

name: Revenant
lore: Those whose souls are lost to the Canyon of the Lost eternally seek form. They inhabit those who wear these boots, unknowingly dragging the soul of the wearer into their ranks if worn for too long, leaving a wandering husk.

name: Capricorn
lore: During a spiritual journey to Kato temple, the sage Capian was presented with powerful spiritual boots with the intention to be used for peaceful magic, and not hard combat.

name: Fatal
lore: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.

name: Lower
lore: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!

name: Braker
lore: Seems like the name is misspelled a little bit.

name: Singularity
lore: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.

name: Knucklebones
lore: An old Nemract saying is engraved along the metal. "A single toss of the knucklebones can make or break a gambling man."

name: Sweet Memories
lore: The feel of cool cream. The savory satisfaction of fatty stew. The bittersweetness of chocolate. Luxuries long since lost alongside what once was, tastes and sensations you can't find anymore. It's enough to bring a man to bitter, bitter tears.

name: Forlorn Pursuit
lore: A hovercraft scrounged from voidstone. Stained glass dulled to bleak grays. Blueprints and notes in indecipherable tongues. Moments, lost in time—like so  much refuse from the world above.

name: Warchief
lore: Sheer strength exudes from these Orcish relics, simple sandals ill-fitting to humans or Villagers. Enchanted with power and rage rather than magic, the strength that is provided when they are worn is unparalleled.

name: Necrosis
lore: 450 years ago a demonic plague like no other spread through Gavel, killing thousands. That is, until a priest encased the disease inside a helmet and warned everyone never to wear it.

name: Hetusol
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] The make of this massive cloak is unlike anything seen before among the provinces. Foreign images shift and melt in ethereal projections within the inside.

name: Sweeping Majesty
lore: Echoes of the Fracturing persist in the Sky at scales unimaginable, implying a power so all-encompassing it leaves you in awe.

name: Monster
lore: This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.

name: Stratosphere
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] Forged from the storm-touched ether, this chest piece calls its wearer to rise above the sky. With every step, the pull of the earth weakens. Jump, and for a moment, you are weightless—caught between the clouds and the stars. Leap, and the heavens may answer.

name: Necklace of a Thousand Storms
lore: Sealed away by the Avos of the old days to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands, this necklace was enchanted to strengthen its wearers spiritual link to nature itself.

name: Propeller Hat
lore: A tag on the inside of the hat reads: "Do not fly during thunderstorms! The wearer is liable for all injuries sustained while using this product."

name: Downfall
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] A fallen link from a chainmail hauberk of an older time, this ring fell from a giant taller than a mountain. As it sped through the air and  gained momentum, it traveled so fast that it was battered to a tenth of its size.

name: Spring
lore: Arrows fired by this bow are pure ice, but when they hit the enemy, burst into magical water, flash-freezing all that it touches. The frost burns will never heal.

name: Cascade
lore: A great magical cataclysm at Mage Island brought on by a strange, seemingly disconnected series of events resulted in this wand absorbing nearly uncontrollably high levels of magic.

name: Petrichor
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Mephistophelian
lore: When the two opposing Realms come to blows, War lashes out with blind enmity. Such is the nature of a Devil, each born from the hate those two Beasts bear.

name: Span of the Starfield
lore: Infinitesimal specks of matter wane in and out of view among the darkness of this clasp. Even a glance reminds you of what little exists in the expanses of the Void from which the materials of this were scavenged from.

name: Aphotic
lore: This dark relic was found at the very bottom of the deepest trench of the ocean. It drains all light surrounding it, blinding everything in a strange abyssal darkness.

name: Blank Stare
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] In the marbling of wood grain. Drying moisture in the cobbles. Clumps of flowers. Tree bark, birth marks, the pattern of this plate - unflinching faces trapped, now revealed. The question pierces your mind: what shape will I be hewn into, one day?

name: The Incomprehensible
lore: After eons spent in parochial search for something familiar, perhaps this blade should have been a hint to think outside the box.

name: Harwrol
lore: The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.

name: Air In A Can
lore: Contents under pressure.

name: Inferno
lore: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of Molten Heights. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.

name: Ghostly Quasar
lore: An eerie glimpse into what once was, shining beautifully in the infinite expanse of the Void. As tragic a tale it is, perhaps it is better left a wisp.

name: Absolution
lore: A deep regret stains this weapon—once a healing implement of the scholar-priest, its gentle power was turned and twisted as his ideals and resolve were tested, and faltered. With its wielder long passed, perhaps it can finally be absolved of the atrocities committed by his hand... and remember the peace it has long forgotten.

name: Divzer
lore: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.

name: Nirvana
lore: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.

name: Collapse
lore: Despite the light weight of the weapon, the spearhead has been made from incredibly dense cosmic stone. A strong enough impact can directly destroy matter. Due to this danger, it is sought after to be destroyed.

name: Cryoseism
lore: One of the first dwarven theories of the increasing quakes in east Gavel was that the freezing of a Dogun town in the Heights also froze a massive underground spring, disrupting the earth and chain-reacting across the province.

name: Grand Design
lore: It’s a gravity as abstract as it is physical, of phenomena so fascinating one can’t help but be pulled in.

name: Virgo
lore: These common leather boots were once owned by a barbarian with no magical prowess. Instead of enchanting it, he coated the soles in corrupted shards to punish those who opposed him.

name: Stardew
lore: Wybels have a strange attraction to cosmic magic, and many an owner will find them staring through the window at night. One, however, claims to have seen her Wybel making something out of white stardust. The abode was robbed shortly after, and the supposed item gone missing without confirmation of its existence.

name: Scorched Antiquity
lore: These hollowed spikes still hold the lingering embers of the event that formed this caldera long ago, lending an almost unnatural glow. It's a comforting warmth, though the force of the eruption remains dormant, primed for the slightest push.

name: Suspended Soliloquy
lore: No one can hold you down anymore.

name: Gaia
lore: The Dernel tribes revere various nature deities, each in their own unique fashions. One of the most notable was that of a lost tribe, who fashioned this blossoming stave as tribute to their deity of the earth itself.

name: Cypress Amber
lore:
"Discernable by it's one-second glow, the cypress firefly makes it home amidst the ash of the upper heights, blending in with the fiery landscape."
 -Delinaed's Guide to Local Species, 2nd Edition.

name: Grimtrap
lore: Found at the site of the Caritat Mansion, this simple-looking glove is bathed in dark presence. It wracks those who wear it with pain, and instills the belief that the only way to end the pain is not to remove the item, but to inflict that same torment upon all others.

name: Dawnbreak
lore: Many prophecies foretell of new eras. Most are fabricated or proven false in time. One passed through the Dogun caverns, however, tells of a dawn soon to break, in which the earth shall run red and return to flame. Fanatical sects whisper the coming of a new demonic god.

name: Taurus
lore: The hide of the Touroto, an almost invincible Bull-like creature, is said to be pierced only by the horn of the Touroto itself, making it extremely valuable.

name: Ephemeris
lore: A pair of glowing sabatons crafted from time-lost relics. Somehow, despite just creating them, you get the feeling that you've worn these before...

name: Lament
lore: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.

name: Morrowind
lore: One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."

name: Song of Solitude
lore: It is an apathy born from lonely desperation with which one sends a blinding ray as their signal flare, uncaring if it hails friend or foe.

name: Ivory
lore: The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.

name: Fantasia
lore: The confusion of sentience creates unknown and marvelous threads and soundscapes. Joy, grief, hate, love, shock, calm, they reflect back into the pattern and song of the universe. The glow of the Weave, and this brilliant, breathtaking, pale imitation of it, too, resounds in the chorus of existence—one extra layer.

name: Thrundacrack
lore: The raw aspect of thunder, though claimed to be harnessed by a mage in a wand, has only been truly tamed by this mighty blade. Combined electric and life-draining magic intertwine and bring forth the truest, most frightening power of all Thunder.

name: Toxoplasmosis
lore: Can you feel the burning inside? Something has made itself at home. Time to tuck away the parts of you it has no need for, to shuffle your little brain around so you may Carry. Carry and Spread. Give it a new home—melting you down is how it says thank you. Be grateful, won't you?

name: Perch of the Shrouded Sun
lore: Able to withstand the grasp of claws of pure steel, the perch of the Minokawa thrums with the might of a beast that can devour the sun. Given free reign of the skies, even the brightest of stars are no match.

name: Hurricane Recurve
lore: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.

name: Cataclysm
lore: Despite the existence of the Nether Portal, few believe that it is possible to open such rifts with sheer force alone. None believe that a tool with enough power to accomplish such a monumental feat could exist. And yet...

name: Lost Tales
lore: You can hardly notice some text engraved on this bracelet. Looking closer, the worn-out inscriptions are telling the legends of an ancient hero whom you do not know of.

name: Weathered
lore: A relic of the past in Time Valley was weathered down to a dagger by the sheer power of the wind. When used in battle, mysterious intertwined wind and time magic give it no physical presence.

name: Summa
lore: An auxiliary power core of the powerful TERA-4M Mining robot line. It controls the robots by giving the bearer a compulsion to break new grounds and progress further without heed.

name: Sunstar
lore: Once known as the Doomsday Weapon, it was ultimately never used for its intended purpose - its solar focus was cracked upon the day of its completion. All but a fraction of its energy was expelled, obliterating its creators, but overwhelming magical force still pulses and thrums through the web of fractures in its design.

name: Nether's Scar
lore: Forged directly from the bloody red stone mined from the Nether, they were locked away for fear of inciting insanity in those who wore them.

name: Gemini
lore: The gods of air and thunder, frustrated with being physically insubstantial alone, decided to band together to forge the ultimate leggings of defense.

name: Diamond Solar Ring
lore: The device forged into this flawless ring draws all heat from its surrounding. Though it almost burns, you can feel your abilites enhance.

name: Nullification
lore: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.

name: Firebird
lore: From the ashes, let a hero rise anew.

name: Silver Solar Ring
lore: The device forged into this simple ring seems to absorb heat. You feel a bit lukewarm when wearing it...

name: Eradian Cuissards
lore: Abandoned by the dwarven Ramriders in their heyday, this hefty armor forged to protect a steed sees little use but littering the steppes of the upper heights. A memento of a slaughter, in days long past.

name: Ignition
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the Canyon of the Lost hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.

name: Silver Hydro Bracelet
lore: You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said. Although you notice the built-in device's abilities, you feel space for an upgrade.

name: Silver Fusion Necklace
lore: This necklace, decorated with bright jewels, uses built-in micro-devices to boost its users elemental abilites. There are many upgrades to be made before it reaches its full potential.

name: Aquarius
lore: “The symbol of the river” is a name that is often synonymous with this garment, with many water like qualities surrounding it, heavily bathed in magical meaning.

name: Gold Hydro Necklace
lore: You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?

name: Gold Static Bracelet
lore: The painful shock coming from this improved version of the ring is a small price for its power, but it has yet to reach its peak.

name: Diamond Static Ring
lore: The heavy electrical impulses coming from this ring would be lethal under normal circumstances, but the only thing its wearer senses is pure power. A true masterpiece of engineering.

name: Silver Solar Necklace
lore: The device forged into this basic necklace seems to gather heat. You can feel a warm sting when holding it.

name: Silver Fusion Bracelet
lore: This bracelet, decorated with simple ornaments, uses built-in micro-devices to boost its users elemental abilites. There are many upgrades to be made before it reaches its full potential.

name: Silver Static Necklace
lore: Though it's hard to touch the plain, tech-enhanced necklace without experiencing a little shock, its capabilities intrigue you...

name: Gold Steam Bracelet
lore: This impressive bracelet is in high demand. Those who have obtained it say that they feel as if they're "one with the wind" when wearing it.

name: Ignis
lore: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.

name: Silver Hydro Necklace
lore: You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said. Although you notice the built-in device's abilities, you feel space for an upgrade.

name: Gold Solar Bracelet
lore: The device forged into this improved bracelet seems to gather heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your arm...

name: Diamond Fiber Bracelet
lore: Desired by many of the countless challengers, this bracelet allows you to sense movements over thousands of meters away. It is decorated with rough yet beautiful jewels.

name: Gold Solar Ring
lore: The device forged into this advanced ring seems to absorb heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your hand...

name: Idol
lore: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the Seavale Reef. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.

name: Silver Fiber Bracelet
lore: This rough looking bracelet utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Though for now, it remains a whispering.

name: Gold Fiber Necklace
lore: This improved version of a bracelet utilizes rare electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. You notice a rhythm with each step...

name: Diamond Steam Bracelet
lore: This steam-powered bracelet is sought by many challengers of the Legendary Challenge. They say that they feel as if they're "one with the wind" when wearing it.

name: Gold Fusion Bracelet
lore: This bracelet, decorated with complex ornaments, uses built-in micro-devices to boost its users elemental abilites. Though powerful, there's still a lot to improve.

name: Silver Hydro Ring
lore: You'll move quick like a river, the merchant said. Although you notice the built-in device's abilities, you feel space for an upgrade.

name: Silver Static Bracelet
lore: Though it's hard to touch the simple, mechanical bracelet without experiencing a little shock, its capabilities intrigue you...

name: Gold Static Necklace
lore: The strong shock coming from this improved version of the necklace is a small price for its strength, but it has yet to reach its peak.

name: Diamond Fusion Ring
lore: This mighty ring is the crown jewel amongst elemental rings. Wearing it, your knowledge is no longer limited to a few elements.

name: Gold Steam Ring
lore: While this model of the Steam Ring is far superior to its predecessor, there still lies the capacity for one more upgrade. The jewel of the ring is crystal clear.

name: Silver Steam Bracelet
lore: Users who have worn this early model of the Steam Bracelet have reported that they have felt "one with the wind" while wearing it.

name: Diamond Steam Ring
lore: Users of this perfect model of Legendary Island's steam-powered ring have reported feeling weightless in combat. The jewel of the ring is a perfectly clear diamond.

name: Grandmother
lore: The very first crossbow in existence was claimed to be utterly indestructible, but it is only true to a fault. The item cannot be broken, but solely because all damage to it is instead reflected onto the user. As its age is uncountably ancient, wielders will find themselves rapidly aging and withering away with even a mere touch.

name: Silver Fusion Ring
lore: This ring, covered in colorful artifical gems, seems to awaken a strong elemental affinity in you. With some improvements to its core, it could become even better...

name: Diamond Hydro Bracelet
lore: You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this bracelet on your arm you could ride a wave with your bare feet.

name: Silver Steam Necklace
lore: Despite the size of the large jewel hanging from this necklace, it doesn't feel heavy at all. However, the necklace's mechanisms seem incomplete.

name: Radiation
lore: Radioactive emissions caused by starfall seeps into the mind, the atoms, the Soul. Transfiguring organic matter into something new, something sinister. It's only through sheer force of will that victims of such a thing break free from themselves, and their imperfect vessels... into something beautiful.

name: Gold Hydro Ring
lore: You'll move quick like a river, the merchant insisted. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?

name: Diamond Fiber Ring
lore: This masterpiece of a ring utilizes powerful electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Wearing it, you can feel a deep connection to the ground below.

name: Silver Static Ring
lore: Though it's hard to touch the plain, mechanical ring without experiencing a little shock, its capabilities intrigue you...

name: Silver Steam Ring
lore: This prototype model of the Steam Ring increases the user's agility in combat. The jewel of the ring is crystal clear.

name: Diamond Fusion Bracelet
lore: This bracelet opens up its wearers spirit, filling it with pure elemental knowledge. The ornaments decorating it are without peer.

name: Shawl of Gaea
lore: Despite being thin enough to blow away in the wind, this mineral-blended shawl holds the force of a supervolcano within its soft fabric.

name: Minokawa's Grasp
lore: The sun fears its wings, and so shall your enemies.

name: Silver Solar Bracelet
lore: The device forged into this simple bracelet seems to gather heat. You feel a bit lukewarm when wearing it...

name: Silver Fiber Ring
lore: This crude looking ring utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Though for now, it remains a whispering.

name: Gold Fiber Bracelet
lore: This rough looking bracelet utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. You can feel a rhythm with each step...

name: Stellar
lore: Elementally attuned gemstones are melded together to form the singular marvel found on this pendant. Despite the violent smithing process, the jewel is utterly flawless.

name: Gold Steam Necklace
lore: The jewel hanging from this necklace is said to be weightless. While still very powerful, its full potential has yet to be achieved.

name: Gold Hydro Bracelet
lore: You'll fight strong like the tide, the merchant said. Indeed, you begin to notice how your senses sharpen. But is that the limit...?

name: Gale's Force
lore: Those who have used this near-weightless bow all seem to tell tales of how they see Gale's spirit fighting alongside them.

name: Diamond Solar Necklace
lore: The masterpiece of a necklace gathers all heat from its surrounding. It is fed to its wearer to maximize the strength of attacks.

name: Ten-Foot Pole
lore: I'm not touching this with a... well. Yeah.

name: Diamond Solar Bracelet
lore: The device forged into this perfected bracelet drains all heat from its surroundings. Though it almost burns, you can feel your power growing

name: Gold Static Ring
lore: The strong shock coming from this advanced version of the ring is a small price for its power, but it has yet to reach its peak.

name: Gold Fiber Ring
lore: This improved ring utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. You can sense a rhythm with each step...

name: Diamond Hydro Necklace
lore: You'll be wise like the sea, the merchant said and every word was true. With this necklace equipped, you could hear the ocean whisper.

name: Diamond Fiber Necklace
lore: This ultimate version of a necklace was given to less than a handful of adventurers. Once on your neck, you can communicate with the ground below as if you grew roots.

name: Diamond Steam Necklace
lore: This necklace is the pinnacle of steam-powered technology. Despite the size of the large jewel hanging from the necklace, it doesn't feel heavy at all.

name: Silver Fiber Necklace
lore: This crude looking necklace utilizes electromagic to expose its wearer to earth's heartbeat. Though for now, it remains quiet.

name: Diamond Fusion Necklace
lore: Unlike any other invention this necklace enhances your power and understanding of the elements tenfold. The colorful jewels used are almost dizzying you.

name: Gold Fusion Necklace
lore: This necklace, decorated with bright jewels, uses advanced nano-technology to boost its users elemental abilities. Though powerful, there are still a few flaws to be fixed.

name: Gold Solar Necklace
lore: The device forged into this advanced necklace seems to gather heat. You can feel a warming sensation all over your neck...

name: Diamond Static Necklace
lore: The lethal amount of electricity emmited from this often desired necklace fails to kill you, as its pure energy runs through your veins.

name: Diamond Static Bracelet
lore: The heavy shocks coming from this perfected bracelet would be lethal under normal circumstances, but the only thing its wearer senses is the enhancement of power.

name: Gold Fusion Ring
lore: This ring, covered in colorful artifical gems, seems to awaken a powerful elemental force in you. Though stronger than the previous model, its true potential stays sealed.

name: Moontower
lore: For the belief of the cosmos’ defilement, the moon was noted to remain unchanged. Those with this belief live only for the light of the moon, desperately seeking to maintain it through means that would only darken the soul of the most devout. Such from them comes the word lunacy.

name: Diamond Hydro Ring
lore: You'll move quick like a river, the merchant said, and no word was a lie. With this ring on your finger, you could catch a gnat without looking.

name: Time Rift
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] You only have limited time. But what if, you could experience that time again? And again, and again...

name: Slayer
lore: Many artifacts are found to incite rage in the wearer, and wizards old and new alike conjecture as to the purpose of them. Very few increase the latent abilities of the wearers to ensure havoc, and none to such a degree as these boots.

name: Greatbird Eyrie
lore: Sculpted by searing flames and dazzling light, in the years since the Fracturing the Greatbirds' nest has developed a blinding glow. It has both immense power and volatility, yet seems to hold a hidden strength for one who can tame its spirit.

name: Sagittarius
lore: The hide of the centaur is extraordinarily magical in the right hands. It is told to allow the user to gain the swiftness of the horse, but also leaves them vulnerable to hard hitting attacks.

name: Phoenix Wing
lore: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.

name: Alkatraz
lore: Soul-locking magic is one outlawed by Gavellian governments, only used by the most insidious and cruel of mages. One such enchantment looms dormant in this mundane-looking maul. Continued usage of the weapon threatens to release it upon the wielder, permanently binding them to the weapon.

name: Hadal
lore: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.

name: Thrunda Ripsaw
lore: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and consuming fury combine to create a deadly aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for utter cataclysm.

name: Zephra Shredder
lore: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and sheer rage intertwine to create a fearsome sight, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for total destruction.

name: Flameshot Hilt
lore: Found abandoned in the ruins of the Doguns, these odd weapons are designed to shoot jets of sheer flame instead of hitting enemies traditionally. They are in terrible disrepair, and none know how to fix them.

name: Leo
lore: This thick skinned jacket, imbued with the courage of a thousand lion hearts, will grant the user massive protection from all who target them.

name: Pain Cycle
lore: Every ounce of your suffering must be made worth it. Otherwise, what was the point of it all?

name: Boreal
lore: The last known crafts of Theorick before his fall in battle were pieces of armour crafted out of pure ice, all of which have melted save for these shimmering boots. The coldest gales and most suffocating heat nurture and repair the wearer instead of being stifling or deadly.

name: Guardian
lore: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.

name: Alka Cometflinger
lore: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and raw potential fuse to create an imposing presence, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for complete obliteration.

name: Nepta Floodbringer
lore: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.

name: Olympic
lore: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.

name: Freedom
lore: Freedom of soul, mind, and body are forced upon all those that this bow's arrows impact, and freedom of caring from the atrocities that such a dangerous weapon can inflict is given to all those that hold it.

name: Esclavage
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Abiogenesis
lore: Life itself is not a flexible material to work with—building sentience is precisely like squeezing blood from a stone. It may be years of toil, but the strength of an entire race that looks to you as a creator cannot be overstated.

name: Protector's Parable
lore: A wolf and a rabbit met in the woods. The rabbit was injured; the wolf spared it. The two grew close. One day, the rabbit fell into a hunter's trap. It was terrified, surrounded by armed men. The wolf burst from the trees, fighting the men back, even as they shot it with their bows, long enough for the rabbit to run away. It never saw the wolf again.

name: Narcissist
lore: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!

name: Aries
lore: Two iron horns adorn this helmet to enhance the warriors of the Eradian, Dwarves who specifically rode Rams into battle at incredible speed.

name: Memento
lore: All those who wear these enchanted boots deposit a single fond memory into them. They are forgotten forever, but wearing them recalls every memory within vividly.

name: Bedruthan
lore: Stone shorn from mountains by the roiling sea gathered on the shores of Llevigar one day, washed onto the sand in the shape of a massive spear. It was taken as an omen, and the stones were forged into a true weapon.

name: Galleon
lore: Forged with the raw powers of both the earth and the sea, these boots were initially an attempt at creating a method of foot-travel over the seas. Despite the spectacular failure of that application, they remain a formidable and reliable set of armor.

name: Daredevil
lore: The mangled body found days too late apparently thought this necklace would let them traverse between geysers into the Upper Heights.

name: Hellstrand
lore: The Order of the Abyss crafted this bow in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.

name: Shatterglass
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] This small, rough-crafted pendant is the only known magic artifact of the Orcs. It incites destructive tendencies within the wearer.

name: Resurgence
lore: An antique passed from the Caritat wreckage into the hands of the outcast elves of Efilim. So to honor the memory of the selfless family as inspired their self-imposed exile, their strongest healing spells were imbued into it, and sent to those who needed them most.

name: Hero
lore: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.

name: Libra
lore: Before the invention of magical weight detectors, there was a giant pair of public scales in Cinfras. Instead of being thrown away, they were reforged to be a formidable piece of armour.

name: Equinox Blossom
lore: Perennial, in a sense—these plants cycle through a unique bloom for every season. When they fully form, the breathtaking equinox is said to shine with an otherworldly light.

name: Kaze
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] Gentle spirits of the wind attract themselves to the brilliant jewels slotted into this ring, bringing peace to its wearers and those around them.

name: Cardiac Arrest
lore: ...As the heart fails, adrenaline pumps through the body in an attempt to provide energy and keep the victim alive, but medical action must be taken to ensure survival. -Excerpt from Aldorei Medical Tomes, Vol. 6

name: Quilted Carapace
lore: This patchwork of shells from the Corkian Astrochelys makes for quite the statement sweater; it keeps your neck warm and besides, your foes' fashion fancies feel frivolous, anyway.

name: Starburst
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Phoenix Prince's Crown
lore: The Phoenix Prince is a mythical figure spoken of in Avos legend. His crown cursed him in an endless cycle of death and rebirth.

name: Scorpio
lore: The carapace of the common Maexi pet fire scarabs, while alone, only cause minor burns to the touch. However, when woven together, they produce a variety of cumulative effects.

name: Bronze Basic Necklace
lore: This necklace is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

name: Untimely Demise
lore: “Death claims your soul...”

name: Return to Ether
lore: This enigmatic weapon can suddenly blink out of reality with no warning only to appear exactly where it was left later. Artificers have determined that almost the entire bow, by all known laws of nature and magic, should not exist.

name: Asphyxia
lore: A condition of severely deficient supply of oxygen to the body that arises from abnormal breathing; practitioners that abuse specific magic combos are often found incapacitated by said condition.

name: Bronze Basic Bracelet
lore: This bracelet is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

name: Sigil of Existence
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Crusade Sabatons
lore: One of the very few physically-powerful artifacts of the Villagers, these boots were used in the initial crusades against the Green-skins, to overpower the Orcs via raw physical might. Though effective, they have not seen use in a long time.

name: Bronze Basic Ring
lore: This ring is awarded to participants of the Legendary Challenge. Its modular design allows it to be upgraded in a number of different ways.

name: Follow the Wind
lore: A lost relic from the Wind Fortress, a mythical stronghold of the Sky Islands that fell into the Void long ago. A small mechanism within the bracelet points towards its place of origin.

name: Alizarin
lore: This bloody palette knife was used to kill only two people before it was abandoned - a killer who broke into a great artist's home, and the artist who struck the blow.

name: Greaves of the Veneer
lore: Forged from mystic, previously unknown metals revealed in the deepest dwarven mining site to date, these sleek, glowing greaves are believed to be utterly indestructible.

name: Squall's Breath
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Discoverer
lore: Wealth and riches...but at what cost?

name: Auxetic Capacitor
lore: This pendant is not much more than a battery on a string, but a curious combination of Avos and electromagic seem to have left it with the ability to charge power from its surroundings on its own.

name: Overdrive
lore: Holding this relik sends sparks through your veins, making your heart beat fast. And faster. And faster and faster and--

name: Tisaun's Proof
lore: The wear upon this broken old battle spear does not affect its ability in battle. The souls of a thousand fallen warriors resound within it.

name: Third Eye
lore: The Bantisu monks have developed this enigmatic sigil in their years of meditation and study. It blesses the wearer with luck and powerful psionic ability.

name: Grillface
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] The old facemasks of the Eradian guards were forged from raw magma, and enchanted to remain searingly hot, so as to brand the wearer eternally with the mark of Rodoroc's elite.

name: Cessation
lore: Nothing more.

name: Zero
lore: The unstable power within this bow is capable of great destruction, but seems to zero out at the most crucial moments in battle. Only the most skillful archers can wield this weapon with confidence.

name: Lunar Spine
lore: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.

name: Blossom Haze
lore: And as the spring bursts, the blossom petals flutter in the wind amongst the ashes of your enemies.

name: Abominator
lore: Who would have thought to ever design something as pointlessly contrived and unusable as this? It's infuriating just to think about...

name: Tisaun's Valor
lore: Tisaun, a warrior tasked to fend off a corrupted siege alone, could find only a thin shirt and rusted spear to use before the attack. He defeated all 1000 enemies without taking a scratch, and his bravery infused his gear with that same strength.

name: Brass Brand
lore: Built by Cerid to accrue raw static charge from the surroundings and direct it at opponents, the blade's chief failing is that the wielder is not rendered immune to their own discharge as intended.

name: Outrage
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] This battered stone mask is of unknown origin, and has no openings for the eyes whatsoever. Indeed, all that can be seen while wearing it is that which makes you truly angry.

name: Wanderer's Purpose
lore: To look and say “I will go there,” and to keep going until you find it... that’s what’s important.

name: Shredder Club
lore: There's a scrawling etched onto the handle: "UNGA BUNGA'S. NO TOUCH."

name: Faustian Contract
lore: Once a contract is formed, and before its details are discussed, a seal is placed on the human's body.

name: Steamjet Walkers
lore: A rogue inventor stole the plans for a steam jet booster from Corkus and reverse engineered them onto a set of boots. While effective, they are dangerous, prone to catastrophic failure.

name: Proxima
lore: This spear is bright enough that it can cause blindness if you look directly at it. Its immense power is limited by its weight; the weapon is nearly impossible to lift.

name: Torrential Tide
lore: The tides of the ocean, once bound, became useful magic power sources. They were once utilized for weapons, but to harness the unstable force of the raging sea was considered too dangerous.

name: Albedo
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Found Footage
lore: Despite heavy damage, this memory core recovered from a fallen Despermech remains usable. Sifting through its contents paints a clear yet brutal picture of the destruction the rogue creations have caused.

name: Procrastination
lore: ...I'll finish writing this later.

name: Runebound Chains
lore: You know better than anyone else that there’s always a sliver of truth behind the tallest of tales.

name: Rikter
lore: Named for an ancient Wynnic word for "Earthquake", this mighty battle hammer causes the very bones of struck enemies to rattle and heave as though the earth itself was splitting under their feet.

name: Conflagrate
lore: Donning this helmet sears your mind with images of a world on fire. These blistering thoughts pressure you to make that world a reality.

name: Iosis
lore: The last step towards purity. Dissolve and coagulate. Be anew.

name: Valse Vaincue
lore: The Wanderer; the Betrayer; the Lunatic.

name: Granitic Mettle
lore: Sometimes it takes a heart of stone to do what must be done.

name: Booster Plate
lore: A marvel of Corkus' electromagical advancements, this high-tech chestplate is equipped with steam jets to boost the user's speed, at a minimal cost to protection.

name: Aersectra
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Black Catalyst
lore: Even simply looking at these odd rings gives way to a compulsion to wear two of them, despite all better judgement.

name: Gadgeteer
lore: This suit was clearly designed by the hand of a mechanic, though its purpose is unknown. There are quite a lot of buttons on it though, so let’s press this one!

name: Jiandan Handwraps
lore: The cloth wraps produced by the canyon Dojo are just that, merely soft cloth. It is left to the users to apply them skillfully in battle, in whatever way they see fit.

name: Old Keeper's Ring
lore: Found on the corpse of the oldest shopkeeper of the Gavel province, the engraved text reads 'GREED'.

name: Dark Shroud
lore: Wearing this deceptively simple shroud causes the user to fade into the shadows, sometimes flickering out of existence for a moment.

name: Bismuthinite
lore: An extremely rare metallic ore only found within the island region of Corkus, it is normally used in decorative dyes. However, a mishap one day caused the discovery of strange and cumulative effects when exposed to traditional magicks.

name: Apocalypse
lore: To forge a weapon such as this from the cursed lava of the portal basin requires dozens, for each smith would lose themselves to the force of corruption before it is finished. The nightmarishly hooked blade serves no purpose but destruction, as intended.

name: Fenmask
lore: This matted tangle of vines and marshland plants contains various herbal remedies woven into it. It is oddly comfortable, despite the thorns coating the inside.

name: Spiritshock
lore: Recovered from the Lexdale Penitentiary, this grisly bow holds destructive capabilities. Used to carry out executions, a precise enough shot can shatter the soul of those it hits.

name: Rewind
lore: Time moves in strange ways around this translucent blade, speeding and slowing, starting and stopping, with no observable reasoning or pattern.

name: Cacophony
lore: Let their souls sing your chorus of victory.

name: Metamorphosis
lore: What you have seen will mark you forever.

name: Gert Super Special Magic Ultistick
lore: Well...it is a very pretty-looking stick, but aside from that it just appears to be a plain old stick.

name: Gale's Sight
lore: True to their promise, these goggles were left as a memento for Ohms when his lover Gale finally died. Light as air, Gale's carefree nature lends itself to those who don them.

name: Altum Spatium
lore: Even looking at this pendant strains your eyes. Should it even exist?

name: Athanasia
lore: May your triumphs live eternal and never fade.

name: Adder Stone
lore: Aldorei charms are often shared and tinkered with by gifted Elves within the commune. Though simple, the stones blessed by elven magic provide soothing energy to the wearer.

name: Provenance
lore: Your success heralds the beginning of something new.

name: Veneration
lore: Revel in the respect you've finally earned.

name: Reckoning
lore: Come to terms with your godlike judgment.

name: Ventus Tail
lore: Fashioned from the cut tails of the now extinct Venti, these nearly immaterial boots are light as air and crackle with lightning.

name: Pristine Antiquity
lore: Smooth yet unassuming, this hollowed piece feels as if it lay untouched for millennia as the chaos that formed eastern Gavel unfolded around it. No blemish nor order, just nature preserved in its most perfect form.

name: Momentum
lore: This golden cuff has an odd time dilation effect surrounding it, slowing all movements significantly, but multiplying the force of impact to a significant degree.

name: Tenuto
lore: This strange pendant has been known to dilate time around the wearer, slowing their movements while greatly augmenting their power.

name: Empire Builder
lore: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of Almuj. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'

name: Blade of Purity
lore: The creator of this polished white blade insists that its true power will never be unlocked, for only those who are not influenced by the elements of the world know truly how to utilize it.

name: Gospel
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Conspirator's Trickpockets
lore: No reign lasts forever. Not while your schemes remain unnoticed.

name: Heracul
lore: Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.

name: Martyr
lore: A recently married man went off to war wearing this wedding ring. Though he perished in battle, his courage and determination empowers all who wear it.

name: Tachypsychia
lore: You will probably irreversibly harm yourself with this, but when has that ever stopped you?

name: Andesite Aegis
lore: Andesite is a stone commonly used for weapons and construction, but tends to be ineffective as armor when impure. This sturdy chestplate, however, is testament to the strength of pure andesite.

name: Obsolescent Panoply
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] A silhouette of forgotten strength, its essence lingering like a half remembered dream. It no longer boasts the sharpness it once had, yet the stories etched into its very being refuse to fade.

name: Twin Minds
lore: It takes two voices to make harmony.

name: Bright Edge
lore: A blade of pure light forms in your hands. It moves of its own accord, a blinding radiance dancing through your enemies, using you as a vessel for its brilliance.

name: Aftershock
lore: The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.

name: Prymari
lore: This staff was expertly crafted from fragile spun glass, and tinted with various magical foci that bend light into its most raw components.

name: Post-Ultima
lore: These leggings are the last remaining piece of a historical set of armor, created with such power as to be thought impossible long ago.

name: Arma Gauntlet
lore: Stories say that should anyone wield both of these fearsome gauntlets in battle, they will become unkillable in a fight. The second gauntlet, however, has never been found.

name: Royal Dusty Amulet
lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It shines with a powerful strength.

name: Royal Cyclone Amulet
lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It whistles with an invigorating tune.

name: Royal Blazing Amulet
lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It glows with a comforting warmth.

name: Royal Stormy Amulet
lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It pulsates with a calming aura.

name: Royal Shocking Amulet
lore: An exclusive amulet given to the most honored knights of Wynn. It crackles with a chaotic energy.

name: Babel
lore: All legends must one day fall, but their legacy shall be remembered forevermore.  These memories exist in the hearts of all,  and pave the path forward in hopes to create a world where all may find peace,  however rocky that path may be.

name: Cold Wave
lore: Feeling the fresh chill of the cold air is all you need to know you're really alive.

name: Puppeteer
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Warden
lore: "I've been wishin' I was dead for a long time."

name: Az
lore: Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.

name: The Forgery
lore: While only a mockery of the original product, this line of helmets became wildly popular before legal disputes and safety concerns halted production.

name: Soul Ink
lore: Taken from the Archwraith by a pious Shaman, this chestplate was immediately abandoned. Its few users since have turned to an all-consuming desire to seek out and realign the last vestiges of purity remaining in the Kander Forest.

name: The Siren's Call
lore: “I have hope in me the likes of which you could never imagine, and despair the likes of which you shall never fathom. If I cannot satisfy the one, then I will indulge the other.”

name: Disfigured Vessel
lore: An imperfect fit, but you can make a better one.

name: Passus Lux
lore: A brilliant relic supposedly originating from the Realm of Light, the creators of these strangely shaped boots are completely unknown.

name: Infernal Impulse
lore: If the depths of hell allows you this, is staying human an equal trade or a fool's choice?

name: Ensa's Faith
lore: The scholar-priest Ensa created this pendant as a personal prayer while his home was under siege. It is rumored to hold the key to enlightenment, but it is unknown as to how.

name: Reliquiae
lore: Ancient and new hearts beat as one.

name: Tenacity
lore: The strength to keep going, to push on in the face of adversity. It's a rare kind of grit, the one that takes hold and won't let go until the task is done.

name: Abyssal Amulet
lore: Used by the Order of the Abyss to aid their summoning rituals, it contains a strange, fiery energy. It has ties with a terrible demon...

name: Marvel
lore: The stellar quality of the coral jewels set into the ring comes from a magical purification process, involving a decade-long soak in mystical Gylia water.

name: Phantasmal Remnants
lore: Memories take on lives of their own, left long enough.

name: Clearsight Spectacles
lore: Ancient magicks are required to make these brilliant glasses, imbued with charity and selflessness. They allow sight beyond sight, rumoured to allow sight of a brilliant realm.

name: Afterimage
lore: This wand is capable of attacks so fast that it appears to flicker in and out of existence. Anyone able to access its full potential will be seen as only a blur to their enemies.

name: Afelis's Locket
lore: A golden locket Afelis always carried with them. Inside is a picture of Afelis embracing a woman in the Detlas square. 'A+E' is inscribed on the front.

name: Blade of Shade
lore: The fabled weapon of the titular dark Assassin, the blade's small stature hides its true powers. Shadows undulate about the hilt.

name: Aphorism
lore: Just because it's been said to death doesn't mean it isn't true.

name: Toaster
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] This peculiar weapon was once wielded by the firey warrior Igbar, who used it to great effect in endurance competitions.

name: Adamantite
lore: Adamantite is a soft metal often added to exotic medicine to increase one's health, but a revolutionary blacksmith on Black Road, created a chestplate with an Adamantite alloy, which is advertised to bolster the users endurance.

name: Helm Splitter
lore: One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.

name: Ethereal
lore: Supposedly based off of the wand of master mage Ethe, this wand is plated with magic-focusing jewels and heavy gold, yet somehow remains entirely weightless.

name: Chakram
lore: Despite appearing as a basic blade when held, strange spiritual magic changes its form into a sharp, ring-like cutting edge when used to attack. Only one person was known to master the weapon's abilities.

name: Scythe
lore: A psychopath claiming herself to be Death incarnate used this dark-bladed scythe on a killing spree that lasted over a year. It reaped hundreds of lives, including her own.

name: Maelstrom
lore: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of Selchar, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.

name: Stave of the Legends
lore: Crafted exclusively by the Temple of the Legends' mages, this stave is honorary to Mages who best the Temple's Grand Magus.

name: Anarchy
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Blood Moon
lore: Imbued with the blood of the first werewolf, it was kept in Gelibord as a trophy before being stolen. Wearing it is said to mimic the effects of the lycanthropic curse.

name: Stifling Spores
lore: The beauty of this peculiar grotto takes your breath away. Unfortunately, its spores do too...

name: Archangel
lore: The unwieldy, yet imposing stature of this massive sickle strikes awe into those who view it. Those who have the will to wield it, however, seem to garner respect from all those around them, as though they had become a god.

name: The Jingling Jester
lore: Jingle jangle, while shaking your bells. Jingle jangle come the pockets of cash... Catch the trickster, send them to hell," their money is gone and off you've dashed!

name: Crystal
lore: Forged on Mage Island, the sparkling liquid-like armour is as hard as obsidian, but light and fluid as water. It glistens with the magic of the ocean winds.

name: Blue Mask
lore: The Blue Mask's physical traits are equal to that of paper, but the mystical properties enhance the wearers personal skills tenfold. The mask is thought to originate from an ancient Dernel tribe.

name: Blighted Seraph
lore:
Your saviour is not coming.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Stalagmites
lore: Although these boots are crafted from corrupted stone, they do not exhibit any corruptive effects on their wearers. Speculation abounds as to the reason.

name: Sodeta Boots
lore: These boots were standard issue to members of the prestigious, and now disbanded, Sodeta Guild, and given as a gift to the owners of Delnar Mansion one day.

name: Impact Winter
lore: Do you think you can survive with a sky choked by snow and ash? More importantly, do you think anything else can?

name: Jungle Rogue
lore: King of the Jungle—it's a title reserved for the apex of the apex, and yet from where you swing across the canopy, this beast of supposed royalty is but another victim of your thievish pursuits.

name: Remikas' Authority
lore: This plain-looking silver bracer is one of the last surviving heirlooms of the first Gavellian king, to be passed down to his heirs. The shimmering metal is said to contain Remikas' soul within it.

name: The Eviscerator
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: The Exile
lore: This indestructible dagger was found floating in the magma of the Molten Heights, with a lament from its exiled smith carved onto the hilt.

name: Phage Pins
lore: Salvaged from the limbs of the Vulcor Adrenophage, they radiate extreme heat,  suffusing the body they attach to with that same heat. It almost feels as though your blood is heating to a frenetic boil.

name: Infernus Aeterna
lore:
From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Pure
lore: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel 50 years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.

name: Spectre
