lore: The dark spectres of the decayed forests have created an insidious helmet to drain the spirit of those who wear it, and become servants to their dark whims. Many have fallen to its allure.

name: Unspeakable
lore: The wielders of this cursed glassen bauble are rendered mute. The effect is reversed after the item is removed, but the longer it is worn, the longer the curse remains.

name: Hesperium
lore: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.

name: Call to Concord
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] Reverberating with the bravery and residual strength of fallen Wynn soldiers, every casualty only serves to harden the resolve it instills in the wearer.

name: Roiling Ruckus
lore: Not knowing what's going on is the best part!

name: Ohms' Wish
lore: "If anyone finds this, leave it at my Gale's gravesite. I promised her a memento, too." This inscription is extremely weathered.

name: Kelight's Shield
lore: Used by the Temple of the Legends' strongest guard, the shielded plating is enchanted with a powerful ward to stave off the effects of the corruption.

name: Millennium
lore: Cosmic energy permeates this deceptively dull-looking chestplate, having been crafted with stardust from a comet that only passes over Wynn every 1000 years.

name: Augoeides
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Remikas' Righteousness
lore: Despite this mace never seeing use by Remikas, it was seen as a symbol of the might of his rule over Gavel. Its true abilities in battle have never been seen.

name: Clairvoyance
lore: The powerful psychic energies surrounding this bow are rumored to increase accuracy, though this has not been refuted by any reliable source.

name: Carnage Agglomerate
lore:
Behind you are the corpses of the weak, of those who deserved to die. Before you are those willing to join them.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Plague Staff
lore: Carried by the Olux Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.

name: Apex Predator
lore: Something must always rule the ecosystem, even one as warped as this.

name: Terminal Velocity
lore:
Don't give them time for even a warning.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Extinction
lore: The Decay swept away countless species. As those memories die, they are lost forever.

name: Atavistic
lore: In the wake of the Decay, the land yearns to return to its old vibrance.

name: Kahontsi Ohstyen
lore: Wielded by the chief of the Tromsian jungle's zombie tribes, the augmentable crystals within it focus natural elemental energies to intense levels.

name: Symbiont
lore: Survival is the shared interest of those in the wilds.

name: Abysso Galoshes
lore: Rumored to be crafted from a Dernic stone, these sinister boots radiate extremely powerful dark energy. They have absorbed the power of the raging seas in their time locked in Sarnfic.

name: Homeorhesis
lore: Stability is not necessarily found in stasis, but predictability.

name: Bad Wolf
lore: The runic message carved on these enigmatic boots cover hundreds of different languages, many of them disused, but what has been translated seems to describe a disaster soon to arrive to the world.

name: Eyes on All
lore: A presence of despair watches over the swamp as the Decay spreads.

name: Rycar's Elation
lore: Created from the lip of a wine bottle and dropped in the mystic waters of Lake Gylia, this glass ring seems to follow Rycar's drunken escapades wherever she wanders.

name: Omnia Mors
lore:
Everything dies. Show those who resist the foolishness of their ambitions.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Soundwave
lore: This bow's thick string fails to shoot arrows effectively, but instead produces low frequency sound waves that erupt from the source in all directions. The sound can implode the eardrums of an enemy with a single strum.

name: Antimony
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Masochist
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Diablo
lore: One of the most unstable wands known to man. Using the bark of the Flerisi trunk, it reaps fiery destruction upon its enemies.

name: Kratke
lore: Spurred on by a drunken bet, the great Thanos smith Kratke improved a pair of leggings from a rival that were once thought to be perfection.

name: Heat Death
lore: Everything slowly loses heat, and will eventually stop moving. Are you prepared?

name: Locrian
lore: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.

name: Cage of Bones
lore: The ancient bones of the demon Garaheth are stronger than steel. They clamp down when worn to constrict the bearer, inciting a slow madness.

name: Call of the Void
lore: Originating from the unspeakable dark land, looking into the helmet will show nothing but darkness. Wearing it is said to reverse your morality, as if it were draining your will to live into the void.

name: Lodestone
lore: The magical oddity known as lodestone has been studied for years as an active counterpart to quartz's passive magical properties. Research continues, but it is valuable when creating magical items.

name: Fierte
lore: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the Molten Heights.

name: Isostatic Rebound
lore:
Death is naught but an inconvenience for the strongest of the corrupted. With time, the weight of destruction will pass, and the fires of War will rise anew from within.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Repose
lore:
Found on the mangled body of a famous Tromsian general fallen to a corrupted siege some time ago, these boots allow the wearer to remain calm and steadfast in the face of overwhelming odds.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Attrition
lore: Outrun. Outsmart. Outlast.

name: Olux's Prized Spear
lore: This expertly crafted spear was forged by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shines brilliantly in even the weakest sunlight.

name: Sludge Slicer
lore:
Many who venture into the jungle are swallowed by the thick undergrowth and are never seen again. This weapon and an accompanying skeleton were found inside the very adversary the spear was meant to vanquish as a perfect display of its owner's untimely demise.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Infinity
lore: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.

name: Olux's Prized Relik
lore: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.

name: Olux's Prized Bow
lore: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.

name: Matryoshka Shell
lore: The armor worn by the enigmatic Matryoshka Idol. It appears to have a nearly uncountably high number of inlets and sockets set inside.

name: Olux's Prized Wand
lore: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.

name: Olux's Prized Dagger
lore: This expertly crafted dagger was smithed by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It can chop through even the thickest of the swamp's clay with ease.

name: Crumbling Foundation
lore:
It always returns a little weaker than what it was before. Perhaps someday, it'll be put down for good.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Molten Fleshmass
lore:
The scorching heat, the shifting bodies, the screeching cries of anguish... they're all the least of your problems now.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Venison
lore: This ancient Elven sacrificial mask contains only a sliver of its previous magic, yet the blessing of the Elven god Entia still greatly empowers those who don it.

name: Living Slime
lore:
It turns out that having an acidic, slightly corrupted slime attached to your hands has benefits in combat... still, you should probably get that stuff taken off before it eats the flesh away from your fingerbones.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Bough of Fir
lore: Crafted from Mandragora roots and adorned with decorative wreaths of Elven pines, these wands are utilized in Efilim's solstice festivals to celebrate each passing year of Villager and Elven comradery.

name: Impulse
lore: Prolonged exposure to the corruption may cause sudden bursts of madness in soldiers. To assure themselves of their sanity, some have even begun to play tricks on their brethren.

name: Purity Filter
lore:
Originally intended to remove corruption from the world in small amounts, the item became ineffective after overuse. Traces of corruption linger in the metal, displaying the futility of attempting such a feat.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Jinxed Coif
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Ohms' Rage
lore: These ancient, spark-coursing greaves are all that remains of the great thunder mage Ohms' favorite golem familiar after a dark force turned it against its masters.

name: Luminis
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Scumlord
lore:
Ooze secretes out of every inch of this quarterstaff. Is it simply just more of the slime harassing travelers in the jungle, or is there something sinister at play?
It's pulling towards something.

name: Scarlet Veil
lore: You're seeing red... Time to see more of it.

name: Buoyant Balmorals
lore: These are congealed and rather gross, but they leave you with an undeniable bounce in your step.

name: Anchoryl
lore: Despite being a much smaller settlement compared to the mighty citadel of Rodoroc, the dwarven smiths of Thanos still can forge mighty products, such as these heavy diamond-alloy boots.

name: Shine Suffocator
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] The radiance of your foes burns bright. You must emanate your brilliance in return. Cloak them in a blinding glow. Smother their luminance with yours. Then after all of their light has faded, yours will too.

name: Reaper of Soul
lore: A grave digger uncovered this blade from the resting place of a notorious pirate that pillaged the islands of the ocean for four decades.

name: Hecatomb
lore:
For the hundreds sacrificed for Troms's survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Jagged Bone Necklace
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Bloodbag
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Hexed Amulet
lore: Although the warlock's curse placed upon this simple, Olux-crafted charm will reduce the abilities of the wearer significantly, its original luck-bolstering properties still are in place.

name: Bridge of the Divide
lore: These leggings hold the interest of many researching the corruption, as they are the only documented case of a non-corrupt fusion of dark and light energy, made of pure twilight.

name: Empathy Purge
lore:
Tiny spikes lining the inside of these boots suppress the grey matter in the wearer's brain, enhancing their capabilities and making them capable of murderous and immoral acts while in this trance-like, numbed state.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Decaybound Spindle
lore: Decay spreads unseen, but you know it spreads, and that is enough.

name: Ragni's Mail
lore: One of the few remaining standard issue mails that were used against the first hordes to emerge from the infamous portal over 1000 years ago.

name: Hero's Mask
lore: It bears the visage of a great hero. Thank you for participating in the Festival of the Heroes!

name: Binding Brace
lore: An oppressively dark aura emanates from this shackle, dampening both the will and magic potency of those that wear it.

name: Broken Balance
lore: Torn scraps of metal line the inside of these boots. They provide no protection, instead forcing a constant adrenaline rush while worn.

name: Cremation
lore:
The dead are often burned to nullify the risk of return. For creatures of corruption, however, that fire can be enough for them to rise again.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Marius' Prison
lore: "I know the Beast may return one day...but these chains shall bind it for eternity." The inscription glows bright in the darkness.

name: Sawdust
lore: Once cursed by a druid who had his grove chopped away by a greedy Villager, it was then purified and mass-produced for sale as armor, to the druid's utter disappointment.

name: Eruption
lore: No one expected the WynnExcavation volcanic site to produce any valuable materials, but this heavy, obsidian-blend bow silenced the critics.

name: Rigor Mortis
lore:
After this crossbow's original wielder fell in battle, its mechanisms stiffened and locked into place. A spark of life, or undeath, can temporarily reverse the effect before the weapon seizes up again.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Fissure
lore: Dwarven folklore tells of this mighty maul, used by gods to break mountains, shape continents, and crack the earth to form caverns.

name: Shinespark
lore: There have been many attempts to create a reliable power system in Llevigar, and this plasma-charged helmet was reforged from a notable prototype.

name: Arterial Spray
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Sage
lore: Discipline and experience is channeled into these wands for 10 years in the Bantisu monastery of the canyon, in the hope that they will pass on its teachings to less experienced users.

name: Temporal Lantern
lore: No eyes see past the dark fog that enshrouds the future. But if you could perhaps light the way, what would you see? Invigorating hope? Or a warning to be heeded?

name: Brainbleed
lore:
An otherwise healthy soldier once writhed and collapsed in the confines of an outpost. His autopsy was quickly canceled when military doctors noticed an unusually rapid spread of corruption in his corpse.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Woebegone
lore:
For some, the psychological impact of the undead incursions becomes too much to bear. They leave their lives behind hoping to find solace, only to return as an undead themselves.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Bloodied Wreath
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Oyster
lore: \[Community Event Winner\]

name: Deadeye
lore: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, Rymek Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.

name: Cerid's Ingenuity
lore: One of the master tinkerer Cerid's greatest inventions, these odd gear-laced boots clink and chime with the sound of clockworks keeping its powerful magic dynamos constantly running.

name: Inclemency
lore:
Only the strongest are able to survive Nesaak's unforgivingly harsh conditions. From the frigid temperatures to the vicious wildlife and grotesque corrupteds, life here can feel like challenge after challenge.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Bob's Battle Chestplate
lore: This battered chestplate was once worn by the legendary Wynnic protector, Bob, during the fearsome corrupted sieges before he gave it away to an old friend. An air of melancholy hangs over it.

name: Lingering Twilight
lore: In the harshest reaches of the mountains, dusk brings a gentle magic to the air, prolonging the faintest vestiges of sundown before night truly falls.

name: Dissever
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Scorpion
lore: This dagger has no blade. Instead, it is layered with the stingers of the Black Shadow Scorpion, which has the ability to vanish entirely from its prey.

name: Mutilated Corpse
lore:
Freshly slain foes in well below freezing conditions often provide enough warmth to weather the storm. However, this Corrupted seems to still be alive in some sickening way, draining life force to sustain itself.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Pulsar
lore: The density of this weapon is almost immeasurable. Despite being light and easy to wield, the spear seems to have its own gravitational pull, slowly dragging enemies closer and making it nearly impossible to put down.

name: Seven-League Boots
lore: Bending the fabric of reality to allow the wearer to take massive strides, these boots are rumored to contain rogue djinni to power them.

name: Winter's Essence
lore: These pure, snow-white leggings are rumored to have been crafted by the legendary ice mage Theorick. The people of Nesaak view them as cursed, seeking to destroy them in a bid to stop the endless winter surrounding them.

name: Pelier
lore: Occasional whisperings can be heard by the wearers of this stone mask, reforged from a phylactery of souls. Although not dangerous, staring into the eyes of the mask can bring fear of one's soul being trapped within.

name: Giant's Bracer
lore: This ill-fitting, bulky chestplate was never intended to be a chestplate at all. Rather, it is a broken fragment of an arm bracer, from the time of giants.

name: Thunderbolt
lore: This bow has no string. Instead, a thin lightning-like thread is strung upon it. It is said to be limited only by the speed of the user.

name: Dogfight
lore:
The Nesaak wolves have been driven to aggression by corruption. Witnesses have seen entire packs decimate each other in fierce and brutal skirmishes. This necklace is adorned with teeth recovered from those incidents, and wearing it gives you the feeling of a wolf about to bite at your neck.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Enhanced Duskshield
lore: They look extremely bulky and uncomfortable...do they have a right to call it "enhanced"?

name: Blazing Bangle
lore:
This bracelet is imbued with both the oppressive heat of the mesa sun and the embers of an extinguished corrupted flame. It is known to spontaneously ignite anything that touches it for too long.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Precious
lore: A strange magic attracts you to this ring. Maybe you shouldn't tell anyone about its existence?

name: Bluetooth
lore: Forged from the fang of a ferocious beast. Despite its small size, it can land blows at considerable range.

name: Glare
lore: The blazing sun has been revered by many druidic sects as a god in its own right, and the jewel in this brilliant wand glows with the brightness of their holy star.

name: Enhanced Assassin's Hood
lore: The chains comprising the mesh are rusty and old. It looks terrible, especially with the newer metal added on.

name: Sticky Decoder Ring
lore: Each one is welded stuck to just one letter. Apparently, to decode the special Rymek message, you need to buy twenty six. ...do they think you're a fool?

name: Weighted Nimble Fingers
lore: The extra metal on the glove completely defeats the purpose... It's unclear why it was re-smithed like this.

name: Upgraded Flare Blitz
lore: The weapon nearly catches fire during the merchant's demonstration. He still refuses to discount it despite this.

name: Dune Kiln
lore: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, Almuj Glassblower

name: Spinal Estoc
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Enhanced Phosphene
lore: The paintjob on the armor is incredibly garish. Who thinks to combine sea green, mud, hot pink, and neon yellow?

name: Sprout
lore: "The plants loathe to take hold upon the red stone. And so, we must hunt instead."  -Caras, Owl Tribesman

name: Holy Greaves
lore: Many blacksmiths have tried to craft their products in this armor's image, but none so far have been able to capture the brilliance of these Bovemist-blessed greaves.

name: Springtrap
lore: "After nearly getting trapped in an iron maiden, I figure I can study  those mummies just as well from home." -Achper, Almuj Archaeologist

name: Diluted Vitriol
lore: The glass capsule holding the poison vial is too cloudy to see what's inside. The merchant's reassurances are anything but.

name: Fierce Thunder
lore: Every time this spear hits an enemy, a sharp electrical jolt hits the users hands that forces powerful lightning to release.

name: Clunderthap
lore: "It never rains here, but we hear the thunder echoing in the distance."  -Lanu, Almuj Archaeomancer

name: Chaser
lore: "My husband's such a scaredy-cat. What good is tomb raiding if you're not in the tomb?"  -Dr. Junes, Almuj Archaeologist

name: Treachery
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Karma
lore: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled Almuj Resident

name: Hashr Claw
lore: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside."   -Attributed to Hashr

name: Nevermore
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Upgraded Long Bow
lore: Apparently, they thought to make a long bow better, they should make it longer. You can barely hold it.

name: Enhanced Salience
lore: Adding hard metal onto a religious cap seems blasphemous to you. The merchant disagrees.

name: Miasma
lore: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert  cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, Almuj resident

name: Chained Pixels
lore: Materials of all sorts have been lashed together in this crude, blocky set of leggings. From darksteel to leather to rotting wood, each part is a perfect square. It has, so far, been impossible to recreate.

name: Mummy's Rag
lore: The accursed mummy once wore this robe as a great pharaoh of the desert. It has long since rotted, leaving only a cursed shell of its former greatness.

name: Enhanced Zeal
lore: Supposedly this chestplate belonged to a legendary paladin. The merchant has no explanation for why there are dozens of them.

name: Upgraded HellRaiser
lore: The blade is covered in tape that's been scribbled on in order to make it look fiery. This doesn't seem like a wise purchase.

name: Upgraded Whisper
lore: The blade seems sharper than normal, but it also seems rather brittle. The smithing was obviously a hack-job...

name: Jaw Breaker
lore: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only 10  emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -Almuj Self-Defense Class Advertisement

name: Influence
lore: This knife does not belong in your hands... yet somehow it feels right at home.

name: Phlebotomy
lore: Rivers will run red in your wake.

name: Enhanced Gypsum
lore: The merchant launched into a tirade on how the hardness scale of stones means nothing the instant you saw part of the boots flake off upon being touched.

name: Tainted Ruby
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Giant Step
lore: Found in a mystically-charged Giant ruin, these snug boots recall fond memories, incite calmness, and provide comfort for the wearer.

name: Broken Sandust
lore: The silver looks rather tarnished...does he expect you to believe that "gem" isn't just a cheap glass bauble?

name: Upgraded Archpriest
lore: It seems stronger at first glance, but upon closer inspection the blade is rather...soft?

name: Grisly Gauntlet
lore:
A thick layer of blood and gore coats this gauntlet. Every time you glance at it, images of being torn to pieces by the undead flash into your mind, and you shudder.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Sol
lore: "The sun and related symbols appear quite often in these ancient glyphs.  Interesting, but unsurprising, no?" -Svin, Legend Keeper

name: Upgraded Phoenix
lore: According to the merchant, the wand is extra flammable, so that it can burn up and disappear with all the mages quicker.

name: Dulled Amethyst Ring
lore: The merchant insists the gem is real. It's easy to tell that the issue is the quality of the gem, though...

name: Mesoskeleton
lore:
Ancient bones, fractured by corruption and the elements, have twisted themselves into these leggings. The armor shifts to fit its wearer before turning the bones inwards, inflicting unending agony.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Ra
lore: Undecipherable symbols are carved into this long arm band, though the fiery glow and bright jewel has led archaeologists to believe it is somehow related to the sun.

name: Dune Beast Jaw
lore: "We're trying to dig up history, not horrors! What is wrong with this province?!"  -Excavator Vade, WynnExcavation Site A Director

name: Enhanced Icarus
lore: Apparently, gluing some feathers on top of the decorative armor wings is supposed to allow you to fly- so says the merchant, at least.

name: Philosopher
lore: What better excuse is there to sit in the shade and think about life?

name: Upgraded Cursed Bow
lore: "100% curse-free or your money back!" The merchant explained that this policy is not legally binding after you read it.

name: Enhanced Skeleton Boots
lore: Some of the bones used to make the frame of the boots have crumbled. The merchant refuses to comment.

name: The Swarm
lore: The scratching in the walls is the only warning you get.

name: Tremolo
lore: "It feels like all these "ancient" civilizations have better tech than we do nowadays."  -Knox, Corkus Immigrant and Sandstorm Vandals bandit

name: Ancient Jazerant
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Mesarock Arch
lore: The two mesa tribes once were allies until their sacred totems were stolen. Before that time, however, they often shared their talents, and this bow hewn from mesa stone was one such lost craft.

name: Enhanced Pickpockets
lore: Aside from the added plating, they look more or less intact. Somehow, that doesn't surprise you.

name: Mummy's Talisman
lore:
Upon the death of a mummy, the curse it inflicts is lifted. Despite the mummy's defeat, its mad shrieks still pierce your ears in moments otherwise tranquil.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Glass Skin
lore:
Peeled off of a desiccated corpse, what remains of the skin is brittle. A precise enough strike can crack the wrapping and embed sharp fragments straight into the wearer's wrist.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Upgraded Echolocation
lore: Did the merchant really think that adding severed bat wings to the weapon would make it more authentic?

name: Enhanced Oxford
lore: They look like at once point they may have been fairly upscale. Now they just look like a metallic mess.

name: Waves Raiser
lore: The mystery of the ocean’s appearance has eluded scholars for centuries. It is believed that many years ago, warlocks used wands like this one in an attempt to submerge the world.

name: Enhanced Meditation Robe
lore: The psalm tag has been replaced with a custom message from the armorer. What it says about the original owner is better left to the imagination.

name: Enhanced Copper Plate
lore: The merchant insists that the wear and oxidation on the armor "is a feature."

name: Cracked Stonehall
lore: It looks like someone tried and failed to improve it. The re-smithing job was obviously rushed...

name: Fractured Lyre
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Erratio
lore: The blind prophet who crafted this macabre breastplate used the bones of only the most ruthless justiciars and executioners. Its wearers are supposedly destined to only die either a heroic or a just death.

name: Upgraded Radiance
lore: The craftsmanship on this bow is rather poor. The paint on the "crystals" is chipping...

name: Chipped Glitz
lore: There are little chips and cracks all over this... was someone trying to break it down for gold?

name: Enhanced Umbrella Hat
lore: The only difference you can see is that a tacky logo for Rymek Armoury has been stenciled onto the top.

name: Upgraded Steel Buster
lore: It is significantly heavier than usual...you can't tell if that is good or not, in this case.

name: Upgraded Lullaby
lore: The inscribed lyrics have been scratched out and replaced with a barely-legible insult.

name: The Berserker's Helm
lore: Worn by a terrible berserker during his fanatical rampage through the land, his rage permeates this horned blackiron helmet.

name: Upgraded Scalpel
lore: The blade actually looks to be of good quality, unlike the other products. The only problem is the questionable stain covering most of it.

name: Goredrinker
lore:
Little spikes of corruption grow out of the blades on this weapon, serrating it. They seem to grow after drawing blood, guiding your body to dig further into the enemy's viscera even after they've already died.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Blossom
lore: A mystical sapling native to the shores of Mage Island has been fashioned into this simple staff. Even uprooted, you notice its continuous growth.

name: Viscera Burst
lore:
Innards, outwards.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Chaleur
lore: This blackiron blade was left to sear in the desert for months on end by a fanatical berserker. It burned him alive as he cut down those who opposed him.

name: Upgraded Vartija
lore: The guard on the spear is smaller, but at least twice as thick. What purpose does that have?

name: Enhanced Hilltop
lore: Looks like it was hastily repainted to match the colors of the mesa. ...but you can see the original greens and browns underneath.

name: Snowtread Boots
lore: According to the tag on the heels, these boots leave a trail of snow no matter  where one walks with them.

name: Desert Cyclone
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Warsong
lore:
Soldiers claim that the sounds of undead hordes are one of the most feared things to hear across Wynn. Wearing this ring, the gruesome cries of corrupted legions permanently echo throughout your mind.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Dead Sands
lore: Found in the middle of the Almuj desert, these greaves slowly engulf everything around it in flames. The heat of the desert sun has seared it heavily, empowering it with the fury of the Sun.

name: Sanguine Spaulder
lore:
Blood, gore, and bone fragments have congealed to your shoulder with the power of sheer corruption. The longer the mass is attached to you, the more of you it takes when you try to remove it.
It's pulling towards something.

name: Misshapen Libella
lore: It's completely impossible to use this for its intended purpose now. It barely can fit on your finger as is.

name: Wybel Paw
lore: Even reduced to just the bones, you can't help but feel bad for the poor thing this paw came from.

name: Alternator
lore: Llevigar's schools of wizardry are notorious for their difficult training regimens. These leg plates, forcing users to balance spellcasting with direct combat, are often cited as the tipping point for successful wizards.

name: Stabsand
lore: The art of endurance fighting is a skill lost to time. However, a thief that to this day has not been caught, imbued this dagger with the very same ability.

name: Bugbite
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Upgraded Melange
lore: There are parts from at least six separately recognizable weapons mashed together to make this. There's no way it's effective.

name: Mud
lore: "Some pigmen snuffle through dirt for things to eat. We dig up that soil to plant our crops in; it's always full of life." -Thomas, Ravine Village Resident

name: Enhanced Coalwalkers
lore: Even ignoring the numerous scorches all over, these boots hardly look any better.

name: Law of the Jungle
lore: An uncountably old relic of Time Valley which has changed owners only through death, there is an inscription carved on it: '⒠⒜⒯ ⒪⒭ ⒝⒠ ⒠⒜⒯⒠⒩'

name: Red Candle
lore: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.

name: Blazing Ruin
lore: One who forsook all others in pursuit of their own gain forced an extension of their own will into existence. This culmination of that will consumes all it touches.

name: Field
lore: "After the Nivla forest fire, I'm glad the corrupteds haven't thought to try and burn the Detlas Suburbs." -Sergeant Klafson, Detlas Legion

name: Nemract's Rage
lore: A year-long monsoon soaked this Nemract-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.

name: Overreach
lore: Quick, over there!

name: Giant's Kneecap
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Enhanced Panorama
lore: They added stilts to the leggings, so that they could "live up to the name." The fact you can barely stand in them is neatly avoided when you ask.

name: Rusted Cog
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Used Wolf Paw
lore: It looks more like a dog paw to you, but you don't feel like risking your life arguing with the merchant.

name: Haros' Oar
lore: The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.

name: Abolition
lore: "Those bloody zombies don't kip down at night, what makes you think a curfew might bally-well help?" -General Graken, Nemract Militia

name: Bloodied Chaps
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Meanderthal
lore: These boots were retrieved from a frozen man, uncovered on an expedition to Mt. Wynn. It is believed that the man had been wandering the world before his death.

name: Vitre
lore: "They say the eyes are the windows to the soul. That's ridiculous, ocular fluids are primarily opaque." -Ragon, Elemental Researcher

name: Uncanny Mirage
lore: Sometimes, wavers in the light reveal visions of fantastical places.  A window or portal rippled into existence for just a moment, then winked out by a breeze.

name: Death's Reach
lore: "We'll ensure that under our watch, all your families will be reunited!" -Haros, of the Banished Legion

name: Garoth's Hope
lore: "Strangest thing, it turns out Creepers are incredibly flammable..." -Garull, Cryptid Researcher

name: Damnation
lore: "I got a name, known far and wide! Run along, you bandit scum, before you have to learn it the hard way!" -Sayleros' Brother, killed by bandits

name: Hymn of the Dead
lore: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, Saint's Row Priest

name: Gold Digger
lore: "With the corruption seemingly tied to the emeralds dug by the Roots, people thought gold was the next best thing, the idiots." -Gerald, Retired Miner

name: Thriller
lore: "And no one's going to save us from the beasts about to strike. We've seen horrors stare us in the eyes, and we're fighting for our lives." -Poe, Nemract Sewer Dweller

name: Upgraded Dark Needle
lore: The magic in this wand seems much weaker than normal...and there's a rather rude message written on the handle.

name: Sanies
lore: "Can anyone else understand that General Graken? Because I can't." -Commander Takan, Nemract Militia

name: Nostalgia
lore: It once held little meaning, another lilac left unnoticed in the quotidian meadows of yesteryear. Yet just its scent brings forth a deluge of memory, crashing down with the force of a time long past.

name: Glacial Crest
lore: Used for endurance training on the Icy Islands, this bow forces the wielder's body temperature to drop to near-hypothermic levels.

name: Little Inferno
lore: It is cold to the touch until worn. Once donned, it engulfs the wearer in excruciatingly hot flames, but never shall the wearer burn; only their enemies will feel the pain of the fire.

name: Brise
lore: "With the hot, dry winds from the Roots and the cold, wet winds from Nesaak, these houses rot faster than you can blink." -Viraex, Elkurn Citizen

name: Cathedral
lore: "The gravestone for the brother of that man, Sayleros? For whatever reason, it didn't have a proper name on it." -Sacre, Saint's Row Priest

name: Disco
lore: Recovered from a corrupted soldier who wore them, it was found dancing instead of attacking those around it. Even after it was killed, it jostled and jerked around like a dancing puppet.

name: Zombie Eye Pendant
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Butterfly
lore: "Time travel cares less about small things like a flapping wing, and more about big things, like becoming your own grandfather." -Martyn, Time Valley Resident

name: Fiend
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Angel Wing Shroud
lore: Out of respect and care for the dead, bovemists cloak them in blessed shrouds to aid their spirits in passing. These efforts, however, are not respected by the dead.

name: Nemract's Ruin
lore: This chestplate was originally created as a memorial ornament to the lost lives of Ancient Nemract before being reforged into a powerful piece of armor for Nemract's guard.

name: Black Ripper
lore: "The skeletons at Ancient Nemract are rotted! is it even physically possible to rot a bone?" -Laen, Nemract Librarian

name: Styx's Grab
lore: "Never wish to see a dead loved one again. In this day and age, they'll come back to see you." -Mylo, Nemract Conscript

name: Legendary Smasher
lore: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.

name: The Divide
lore: Once having held unstoppable amounts of magic, being forced to fuse into one form locked away all but the smallest sliver of their power.

name: Almuj's Walker
lore: There used to be a constant battle between Almuj's thieves over these feather-light, gold-plated boots, until one day they were stolen by an unknown pickpocket and never seen again.

name: Conductor
lore: Using an unorthodox method of smithing, these copper leggings are insulated with an extremely conductive blend of liquid to improve electrical discharge.

name: The Swordfish
lore: The ocean's bounty is full of many strange things. Sailor's tales of a peculiar fish with a snout like a sword and the unbelievable stories of its power thus inspired fanciful ideas in blacksmiths. The results speak for themselves.

name: Detlas' Legacy
lore: One of Detlas’ buildings was struck by lightning 60 years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.

name: Backbiter
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Durum's Serenity
lore: Carried by the Durum Protector, this small necklace holds but an ounce of the vibrance and life of the Durum Isles.

name: Intestine Lasso
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Putrid
lore: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, Nemract Sewer Dweller

name: Coeur Brise
lore: Left to brittle introspection, love unrequited stings the most when it brings down something built to last.

name: Effervescence
lore: \[Community Event Winner\] They say the first sip of the ocean's wrath fizzes like champagne. The second burns with a sharp saltiness. By the third, the bubbles rise from your own drowning lungs as the sea claims its aperitif.

name: Dead Samurai's Plate
lore: "We get a lot of weirdos coming from Gavel by airship. That plate mail looked unusably ornate!" -Calo, Private Airship Operator

name: Katoa's Warmth
lore: Brilliantly golden as the crops from the humble farm, its mere presence fills stomachs and brings comfort, but only to those who are modest and generous.

name: Web Plate
lore: "I just need a little more spider silk to finish this vest!" -Lacrona, Detlas Tailor, found eaten by Nivla spiders

name: Brainy Beanie
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Pyrexia
lore: "I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist

name: Match
lore: "Controlled burns are healthy, but it's clear why no one wants to do them." -Darek, Alekin Trailblazer

name: Maul
lore: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, Detlas Legion

name: Arakadicus' Body
lore: Long strips of chitin discarded from the mother of spiders Arakadicus still contain traces of her wicked powers, but few have survived the attempts to harvest them.

name: Hex-Master Anchor
lore: Having felt the power of the Keep's hex, this jewel carries a familiar weight. Much like the Hex-Masters before you, you find channeling curses comes like second nature.

name: Cyclo
lore: A centuries-old storm spirit was banished to these tight boots for his destructive actions. His fury empowers those who wear them with the great force of a raging cyclone.

name: Almuj's Daggers
lore: The reigning king of thieves in Almuj’s underworld would brandish this golden dagger to his enemies so fast, you wouldn’t even realise your wallet was now missing.

name: Web Spitter
lore: "And you thought walking into a cobweb was bad." -Ope, Ragni Botanist

name: Glaring Issue
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Abdomen
lore: "...But under no circumstances should you stand directly behind an attacking spider. While not a universal trait, some spiders are capable of ejecting webs from their spinneret, leaving assailants and victims helpless." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

name: Stingy
lore: "You should see when the spiders fight over a meal. It looks ridiculous, legs flailing everywhere!" -Captain Enduyn, Ragni Legion 1st Division

name: Neolithic
lore: This ancient stone-hewn helmet is blended with the bones of an extinct animal of some kind. It is harder than dragon's hide.

name: Buster Bracer
lore: A mighty, earth-shatteringly powerful weapon was destroyed for fear of its raw power, and the pieces buried. They were unearthed decades later, and were reforged into various items including this sturdy bracer.

name: Iklaj
lore: "I am not making this up! That spider teleported ONTO MY FACE!" -Stiba, Elemental Researcher

name: Silk Slasher
lore: "Cut a web, and its owner will feel it and come out. That's your chance to strike." -Lieutenant Van, Detlas 2nd Regiment

name: The Berserk
lore: Forged from unbreakable obsidian eras ago, this heavy hammer has crushed many foes with a single swing.

name: Hourglass
lore: "I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant

name: Spinneret
lore: "...Spiders have a weak point in the cephalothorax, essentially the neck. A small target, but it isn't as tough to chop through as the rest of them. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

name: Fangs
lore: "Not every spider is venomous, but do you really want to get bitten by them all to figure out which are?" -Alvin, Nivla Forest Resident

name: Ivy Whip
lore: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage

name: Sting
lore: "I swear on my life those spiders were covered in spikes! Go out there, see if I'm wrong!" -Suri, Elemental Researcher

name: Spider Ring
lore: "Crawly things. They crawl on the mushrooms. Mushrooms shouldn't be crawly!" -Yahya, Mushroom Man

name: Lemon Legs
lore: Due to an unfortunate accident where he choked on a lemon, an unremarkable mercenary became a laughing stock. He later managed to shed the title, as he left no one alive who remembered the name.

name: Reticence
lore: Many old mages had to perform lengthy incantations to make potent even their simplest spells. A mage cursed to be mute, however, brought upon a revolution to spellcasting through this simple wand.

name: Skin Piercer
lore: The average bow can boast a range of skills, but unlike this one, not every bow can penetrate through any organic skin, including dragon hide.

name: Hunger
lore: Forgotten long ago, these boots curse the wearer with an endless hunger.

name: Cephalothorax
lore: "...Most of their vital organs, however, are located in the bulbous abdomen. If you've enough crushing force with your weapon, it may be a quicker alternative for the kill. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

name: Omnitread Boots
lore: Plated with enchanted metals, these magic-warding boots allow faster travel over nearly any solid surface.

name: Golem's Arm
lore:
The stalwart Guard Golems stand as the protectors of Wynn's cities. To wield the remains of one so viciously dismembered by the undead... just how deadly are these hordes?
It's pulling towards something.

name: Iron Knuckle
lore: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.

name: Boil Lance
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Relic
lore: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.

name: Chimaera
lore: The one true Chimera in existence is sought by many, for great stories are told of its gifts to the worthy. One such gift was a simple fur coat, which gave the wearer but a taste of its power.

name: Clash Hook
lore: The wear on this humble war pick's blade has only made it more effective in combat, allowing its users to make unexpected parries of opponents' attacks by hooking and hitting through the weapon.

name: Ribcage
lore: "...as intimidating as the name sounds, you want your organs to be trapped in this kind of cage." -Excerpt from Human Anatomy For Fools, Cirh Nettan

name: Witherhead's Elbow
lore: Wielded by the master of the Decrepit Sewers Dungeon, the arrows of this bow causes the target's body to slowly wither away.

name: Bovine Killer
lore: This helmet was worn long ago by an infamous assassin who plagued Bovemist sites for decades. It was crafted of the still-bloody skin of their most prized and worshiped cows.

name: Witherhead's Talisman
lore: "My dear boy should never have to go through the horrors of losing a mother like that." -Momo, adoptive mother of Bob

name: Ancient Wand
lore: It is thought that this primitive wand was used by early man to create the first spells. It is made from a wood that no longer exists.

name: Opulenity
lore: Made of an uncommonly used fabric called denim, these fashionable leggings exude style and elegance. Surely wearing them would bring you luck?

name: Master
lore: Although not truly magical by any means, the sheer craftsmanship of this ornate broach makes its wearers feel skillful.

name: Serpent's Kiss
lore: "I bet those sewer-dwellers have horrible morning breath." -Folzoy, Maltic Escort

name: Crackshot
lore: This heavy crossbow forces a strange compulsion in its users when wielded. They will often refuse to even shoot unless entirely certain of a hit.

name: Skull Breaker
lore: "Even a corrupted would get crushed by one of these!" -Roche 'Stone-thrower' Diamant, Ragni Citizen

name: Cauterizer
lore: ...It's pulling towards something.

name: Stale
lore: "There's never new water flowing into those sewers. It all cycles back into itself...not natural." -Jenprest, Ragni Legion 2nd Division

name: Audacity
lore: A powerful mental curse surrounds these boots, inciting uncontrollable rage into the wearers, as well as the power to enact it upon others.

name: Knee
lore: "I thought aiming for the legs would disable the enemy. Turns out they can drag themselves with their arms just as quick." -Therck, Ragni Soldier 3rd Division

name: Dislocater
lore: Often, the leader of brute gangs would use this dagger to threaten his followers into making sure they did not fail him.

name: Defibrillator
lore: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, Maltic Citizen

name: Heliophilia
lore: This peculiar shawl is eternally warm to the touch, and shimmers brilliantly in the sunlight. It is rumored to give amazing health benefits and good fortune to those who wear it.

name: Concentration
lore: The forger of this ring had to endure 30 long days of smelting various metals only found in the ocean. A single mistake would ruin the creation. The mystic metals are said to seep into the wearers skin to gently replenish their resolve.

name: Corpse
lore: "Catch a fresh-raised corrupted, it's like catching a soldier without his morning coffee. Stumbly and unfocused." -Enzan, Retired Ragni Soldier

name: Macabre
lore: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of Ragni

name: Sketiq
lore: "As much as they're terrifying, at least those lousy skeletons give us lots of bonemeal for the crops!" -Bylvis, Katoa Ranch Farmer

name: Maltic's Old Spear
lore: This short spear was the first weapon to be produced by the villagers for sale. They are old, but strong.

name: Harsh Noise
lore: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from Time Valley were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.

name: Blessed Wrappings
lore: The thick, Bovemist-sanctified cloth is worn by their priests during certain religious ceremonies. It clears the mind and purifies the body.

name: Guard's Garment
lore:
The previous owner seems to have met an untimely fate in the undead hordes outside Ragni. Stained but salvageable... a little corruption never hurt anybody, yet....
It's pulling towards something.

name: Iron String
lore: Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.

name: Darkiron Scrap
lore: Despite being only an impure scrap of the normally sturdy blackiron, these heavy leggings still have extreme defensive capabilities.

name: Pine Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "Let me NICK a few extra cookies for Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

name: Wynnter Fair 2016 Souvenir
lore: Thank you for participating in the 2016 Wynnter Fair!

lore: The sweater has the quote "Why be merry? CLAUS I said so" knitted onto the front.

name: Pink Wynnter Sweater

name: Red Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "I'll never give you the COLD SHOULDER" knitted onto the front.

name: Rarity
lore: Being one of the absolute rarest treasures in the world, it seems to have a mind of its own, only showing itself when a stroke of luck is had.

name: Orange Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "ORANGE you glad I showed up for Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

name: Wynnterfest 2016 Souvenir
lore: Thank you for participating in Wynnterfest 2016!

name: Beige Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "All STOCKINGED up for the season" knitted onto the front.

name: Indigo Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "GRAUPELING with a second helping of Craftmas feast" knitted onto the front.

name: Cerulean Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "SLOPE to SKI you again next Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

name: Mask of the Spirits
lore: Not all who roam may find their way home. Others lose themselves in the world... And find a new way forward.

name: White Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "SNOW way Craftmas can be bad in this sweater" knitted onto the front.

name: Purple Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "ICY you looking at my fancy duds" knitted onto the front.

name: Brown Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "YULE see me smiling this season" knitted onto the front.

name: Cinfras Souvenir T-Shirt
lore: The shirt has the quote "I went to the Letvus Airbase in Cinfras and all I got was this lousy T-shirt" printed on it.

name: Black Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "Prepare for a FLURRY of Craftmas spirit" knitted onto the front.

name: Wynnter Fair 2017 Souvenir
lore: Thank you for participating in the 2017 Wynnter Fair!

name: Contest Wynner Cap
lore: I won!

name: Yellow Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "YELLOW- How's your Craftmas going" knitted onto the front.

name: Blue Wynnter Sweater
lore: The sweater has the quote "Don't feel BLUE- It's Craftmas!" knitted onto the front.
